subjects.displayTitle: Exhortations and counsels: words that become a way of life
subjects.introduction: Good counsel is a form of care, and Bahá’u’lláh gives it in the voice of someone who wants a particular person to flourish: be generous in prosperity and thankful in adversity, be a treasure to the poor, say to no one what you would not wish to hear. Such words come alive only when lived, and the Writings insist that deeds are the witness to words, so that honesty in one’s dealings, a tongue free of backbiting and the refusal to shed blood become the real test of belief. Counsel also has a manner and a moment: a soul of weak faith is to be exhorted gently, harshness avoided because it hardens obstinacy, and action paced between slowness and haste. James’s mirror, in which a hearer forgets the face he has just seen [1], and the two houses in the storm at the close of the Sermon on the Mount [2] press the same question from another tradition. The road runs on into words versus deeds, honesty in daily work, and the wisdom that knows when and how to speak.
subjects.arc: Counsel as a way of caring → When words become deeds → Seeing and addressing one another kindly → Trust, justice and ordinary responsibilities → Strength that refuses harm → Learning to hear and understand → Education and the circumstances of particular lives → Wisdom in giving and receiving counsel → The work of unity → The call of revelation and faithful response → Counsel in adversity → A life of service and thoughtful utterance → Remembrance, gratitude and the value of time → Counsel carried into the world

order.why: Open with the whole sequence of generosity, gratitude, hospitality and humility, inviting the reader to imagine counsel as a way of being present to others.
shortened: O 'Ali, son of Muhammad!
Be generous in prosperity, and thankful in adversity.
Be worthy of the trust of thy neighbor, and look upon him with a bright and friendly face.
Be a treasure to the poor, an admonisher to the rich, an answerer of the cry of the needy, a preserver of the sanctity of thy pledge. Be fair in thy judgment, and guarded in thy speech.
Be unjust to no man, and show all meekness to all men.

order.why: Follow generosity with reciprocity in both speech and desire: consider the other person’s experience before offering advice.
shortened: Say not unto anyone that which thou wouldst not wish to hear from another, and desire not for any soul that which thou wouldst not desire for thyself.

order.why: Let the treatment of those whose faith is weak test the manner in which a community gives counsel.
shortened: And if you find a suffering soul, treat him with mercy and befriend him with forbearance, and if you encounter a soul of weak faith, remonstrate him not and exhort him with kindness and with a sweet and gentle tongue so that he may recognize the Faith of God in his inmost heart and comprehend that which he was bidden by the All-knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Place humility and love for people of every race and religion near the beginning; retain the reported address’s own authority.
shortened: You must manifest complete love and affection toward all mankind. Do not exalt yourselves above others, but consider all as your equals, recognizing them as the servants of one God. Know that God is compassionate toward all; therefore, love all from the depths of your hearts, prefer all religionists before yourselves, be filled with love for every race, and be kind toward the people of all nationalities.

order.why: Connect knowledge of God with the love, mutual assistance and unity that the passage calls its first fruits.
shortened: Say: O servants! Hearken unto the counsels of the Wronged One. The first of all things and of every mention hath been the knowledge of God. He is the Sustainer of all and the Educator of all. The first thing that proceedeth from knowledge is the love and unity of the servants, for through unity are the horizons of the world illumined and brightened.

order.why: Keep the prohibition of bloodshed and the call to teach oneself before others together with concern for the poor.
shortened: Say: O people! Fear God, shed not blood, oppose no soul, and be of the doers of good. Beware lest ye spread corruption in the land after its reformation, and follow not the ways of the heedless.

order.why: Let the possibility of eloquence through quiet conduct deepen the opening invitation.
shortened: The divine friends must become entirely articulate and become the true dawn, and despite quietude give forth the gift of eloquence, meaning that with perfect dignity and composure they must awaken souls through their conduct and behavior. They must become the essence of sanctification and the sign of detachment. The lights of severance must shine from their faces and the signs of the Greater Guidance appear on their foreheads.

order.why: Bring the reported address’s truthfulness, honesty, forbearance, kindness and spirituality into the opening picture of a lived response.
shortened: First--Truthfulness; no one should ever tell a lie!
Second--Honesty in all their transactions.
Third--Forbearance is necessary.
Fourth--They must observe the utmost kindness, so that all may consider themselves servants of each other, and be truthful and honest to all mankind.
Fifth--They must not disappoint anyone, but constantly endeavor to become more spiritual.

order.why: Conclude the opening movement with concrete service to the poor, children, the sick and refugees, preserving the report’s full context.
shortened: Abdul-Baha went on to say: "Be very kind and serve every one; become lovers of justice and pray for the whole of mankind; help the poor and the children; heal the sick; shelter the refugees; and be known by your lives as the children of God; so may that sun become the light of the world, casting its radiance upon East and West.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: O ye two well-loved handmaids of God! Whatever a man's tongue speaketh, that let him prove by his deeds. If he claimeth to be a believer, then let him act in accordance with the precepts of the Abha Kingdom.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Say: O My loved ones! Hold fast unto goodly deeds and follow not those who hold fast unto words rather than deeds. These, verily, are among the heedless. Say: It behoveth you that from you should be wafted the sweet savors of My morals and the holy, mighty, pure and radiant fragrances of My deeds throughout all worlds.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: For today it is binding and obligatory upon everyone, whether female or male, that their deeds be in accordance with the divine good-pleasure. The Truth has, in most of His Tablets, commanded His maidservants and servants to perform praiseworthy deeds, for through goodly acts and pleasing conduct has the Cause of God been and continues to be made manifest among His servants.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Today one must aid the Cause of God through the hosts of spiritual virtues, goodly words, and deeds that are pleasing and acceptable. These hosts are and have ever been mightier than the hosts of the world.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: The eye of God's loving-kindness is turned toward His loved ones, and He counseleth all to such deeds, actions and utterances as will cause the exaltation of God's Cause, and whose very performance will testify to their sanctity and detachment from whatsoever is contrary to the Book of God.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: In most of the Divinely-revealed Tablets We have enjoined upon all wisdom, unity, laudable deeds and a praiseworthy character. Though all have read these, and become aware of the Divine precepts, yet have they remained far distant from the Straight Path, and given precedence rather to their own desires.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: The point is that today there is no salvation or success except through following and acting according to divine counsels and exhortations. These heavenly teachings are what will revive Iran, but conditional upon their being put into practice.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: We make mention of Our loved ones and counsel them to perform goodly deeds and display praiseworthy conduct, and to do that which distanceth man from ignorance and draweth him nigh unto knowledge, sanctifieth him from corruption and adorneth him with reformation.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: We counsel the loved ones of God with that which conduceth to the elevation of souls and the reformation of the world. No host hath been or is mightier than goodly deeds and pure character. With these hosts must they conquer the citadels of hearts.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: And after presentation of the letter, they said: God willing, may they hold fast to that which was imparted to them face to face, and in all circumstances call the people to goodly conduct and the fear of God, that perchance through the grace of the Lord the characteristics of the self and satanic imaginings may be lifted away and spiritual qualities may become manifest from the mines of the hearts of the servants.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Thou must needs hold fast to such goodly deeds and praiseworthy character that their fragrance shall be diffused. In all conditions God hath confirmed and will confirm thee.
Be thou assured and be of those who are steadfast.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: We counsel all to observe that which hath been revealed in the Book of God. Whoso acteth in accordance therewith in this Day is reckoned among the people of Baha. Say: It behooveth you to observe goodly deeds, and again goodly deeds.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: We counsel all to perform pure and holy deeds and to fear God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy. One pure deed amongst the deeds of former centuries is as the sun amongst the stars.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Say: O people of the earth! Cast away vice and lay hold of virtue, by the command of One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise. Your riches and whatsoever ye possess shall profit you not. Cast away vain imaginings and take hold of that which hath been vouchsafed unto you from God, the Lord of all worlds.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: It is my hope that all the friends will arise in the service of the Cause; that they will live in accord with the Teachings of Baha'u'llah and the contents of my addresses; so that these Teachings may not become like Bible, unfulfilled.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Today is the day for the manifestation of deeds. We have ever counseled the servants of God to fear God [...]
It is hoped that the effulgences of the Luminary of utterance which have shone forth from the horizon of God's Book will illumine all and adorn them with the raiment of the Most Great Infallibility.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: We have counselled all in what shall profit them in the hereafter and in this world. Blessed are they who act!

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Strive that from the trees of existence such fruits may appear and become manifest as befit the station of man. This is the counsel of the Peerless Friend unto thee and unto His friends.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Say: O people of Baha! Fix your gaze upon the Most Exalted Horizon and turn unto the Source of His Cause.
Today, goodly words and righteous deeds are the manifestors and revealers of His Cause. Blessed is he who holdeth fast unto them. Woe unto the heedless!

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Man must needs possess human qualities. Through God's loving-kindness, all the friends must manifest goodly deeds and spiritual qualities. Every good deed is today, and shall continue to be, the cause of the exaltation of His Cause.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: This Prisoner counseleth all to perform such deeds as shed abroad the fragrance of sincerity. Work ye according to that which ye have been commanded in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds.

order.why: Ask how the inner claim becomes recognizable in action and character.
shortened: Blessed is the soul whom the ornaments and colors of the world have not deprived of the ocean of divine knowledge.

Blessed art thou for having held fast unto that which is praiseworthy, detached from every remote clamourer. However, We counsel the loved ones to perform good deeds and display praiseworthy conduct, and to observe that which God hath revealed in His Book.

order.why: Begin the movement on kindly attention with the possibility of good intentions and hidden obstacles.
shortened: At all times one should consider positive possibilities in matters and attribute good intentions, or hidden obstacles. When this is one's approach, peace of mind and tranquility of conscience result; otherwise one is constantly tormented.

order.why: Restore the counsel about wise correction before the explicit rejection of faultfinding, cursing and declaring fellow believers infidels.
shortened: Associate amongst yourselves with love and affection, and be not of those who search into people's deeds to find fault with them. By My life! Such people are among the heedless. Do not pronounce as infidels those who have recognized God, and curse not those who recite the verses of God with humility. Thus does the Pen of your Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, counsel you.

order.why: Examine the warning against disguising criticism and backbiting as care for the Faith.
shortened: Some of the friends secretly criticize other friends and instigate backbiting with consummate gravity, calling it care for the Cause of God. You must certainly exercise the utmost vigilance and explicitly forbid everyone from this, for no habit is more harmful than this trait of fault-finding, especially in relation to the Cause of God. Never should anyone express a word or hint that is unworthy about any of the friends of God.

order.why: Preserve this reported illustration attributed to Christ without identifying it as a Gospel passage.
Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: As much as you can, show kindness to all people and befriend every stranger. Be gentle with every sinner like an intimate friend and treat every heedless one kindly like one who is aware. Do not hurt any heart, even if it belongs to an oppressor or traitor. Do not sadden any soul, even if it repeatedly gives poison. Seek freedom for every injured one and give joy and gladness to every dejected one.

order.why: Retain the explicit warning that harshness can intensify obstinacy, and the instruction to leave the person alone.
shortened: And if there are any weak ones among the believers, deal with them gently and give counsel - do not be harsh, for harshness causes intensity and obstinacy. Leave them to themselves.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: You must show the utmost consideration and conduct yourselves in a way that brings them joy. In this wondrous Dispensation, all matters must be carried out with gentleness and love. If some matter causes distress and anxiety among the women, show consideration and convince them, dealing with them with love and kindness, lest certain individuals with personal motives find an opportunity - for a few lie in wait for such occasions.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: O friends! Listen with the ear of the soul to the counsels and admonitions of the Ancient Beauty. As much as you are able, hurt no one's feelings and sadden no heart. Be the cause of joy to hearts and the source of gladness to the world of humanity.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: The friends of God must regard creation with the eye of loving-kindness and draw all to the horizon of guidance through kind counsels and goodly deeds.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: We counsel all to love, mercy and fellowship. Verily He is the Lord of creation, the Merciful to His servants, the Protector of lands. There is none other God but He, the Commander in the beginning and in the end.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Under all conditions, hold fast to the cord of mercy and regard all with grace. Ye are the flowing rivers that branch from the Most Great Ocean; ye must sacrifice yourselves for the advancement of the world.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Be benevolent to all the people of the world. Uphold justice and equity among all the people. Be the sign of mercy and the dawning place of the compassion of The Ancient Beauty. Endeavor to reform and reconcile. Strive to acquire divine virtues and attributes, so that like unto the trees in the Garden of Mercy, ye may bear leaves and fruits and ye may be as generous as the abundant clouds of springtime.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: You must at all times call every soul to forbearance and calm and encourage them to tread the path of godly character and spiritual truths, and inspire them to walk in the footsteps of the martyr in the path of God, Ism'u'llah Al-Asdaq.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: We bid thee deal with kindness towards his family and with justice and equity in all matters. We have counseled thee and them that believe in Tablets numerous with that which shall cause the Cause of God to be exalted above all else and shall make manifest your station amongst the religions.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Deal with him in such matters that the fire of sedition may not be kindled between you, for this is nearer unto grace, and We have ever been gracious. Moreover, counsel him with wisdom and goodly exhortation, and contend not with him lest enmity arise between you, until God shall bring about His purpose.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: We counsel you to fear God and to that whereby His Cause is exalted amongst the servants. Consort with all people with spirit and fragrance, and remind them with wisdom of that which will profit them in the beginning and the end.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: With every group, even if it be an oppressive party, they must act with the utmost trustworthiness, religiosity and kindness. This is the path of the Baha'is, this is the way of the spiritual ones.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: At most it is that one is ignorant and should be taught, is sick and should be treated, and so on.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Tell them that if they would attain nearness to the Blessed Beauty they must love much, for love is everything.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Say: O servants! We have previously stated that ye are all the fruits of one tree and the leaves of one branch. In the station of love and kindness be as rain-laden clouds, and in seizing the conditions of self and passion be as a blazing flame.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Verily she who did what she did erred and disobeyed her Lord and committed a grievous transgression. Thou shouldst not object to her - leave her to herself. Verily thy Lord is the Ruler over what He willeth. Such matters from the beginning should be conducted with kindness. This is what God hath decreed in His Gracious Book. And if you were not pleased with her actions, no blame attacheth to you.
As for the loss caused by the child, leave it to God, exalted be His glory, and be mindful of the wisdom mentioned in the Books and Tablets.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: Be thou steadfast in thy love, then consort with the people with wisdom and speak unto them with wisdom, for this is a beautiful command.

order.why: Explore the habits of attention, speech and correction that preserve dignity and make growth possible.
shortened: O son of Abhar! Look not at the people and their deeds, neither be thou grieved by their derision, their words and their actions. Fix thy gaze upon the Most Sublime Horizon, and voice His praise in the kingdom of creation.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: O Hasan! Beseech thou the True One to enable thee to build an edifice, whose foundation shall be piety, whose walls shall be divine confirmations, and whose roof shall be fidelity and truthfulness.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: O servants! Practice truthfulness, turn not away from the destitute, make mention of Me before the great ones, and fear not.
O servants! Be pure in your deeds and follow the word of your Lord.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Verily My Most Exalted Pen counseleth all who are in the kingdom of creation to observe the Most Great Trustworthiness.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: However, the cause of success and prosperity is trustworthiness and religiosity and effort and zeal, and conduct and movement according to divine teachings. Strive in your work but trust in God.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: We counsel all to observe trustworthiness, chastity, sincerity and faithfulness. We beseech God to aid them all to perform good deeds and eschew evil, and likewise to adorn them with the ornament of unity. The world is illumined through unity and concord, and laid waste through discord and dissension. O friends! Know ye the value of these days and with utmost love, fellowship and wisdom, remind the servants, that perchance they may turn to the supreme horizon through the fragrances of utterance and hold fast unto the divine commandments.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: It biddeth the people to observe justice and to work righteousness, and forbiddeth them to follow their corrupt inclinations and carnal desires, if perchance the children of men might be roused from their slumber.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Say: The Wronged One of 'Akka counseleth all to fear God and to that which exalteth the station of man. The true Law of God consisteth in such matters and deeds as are the cause and source of the manifestations of human stations. This is the good that hath been enjoined in all the Books of God, exalted be His glory, and whatsoever is contrary to this station is accounted as evil and must needs be shunned.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: At this point They gained presence in the Holy Court and said to write to Zaynu'l-Muqarrabin: "O Zayn! The Wronged One counsels His loved ones with that which will elevate their stations before God: pure fear of God, goodly deeds, trustworthiness, religious devotion, chastity, truthfulness, patience, steadfastness, deliberation and reflection, and acting according to what they have been commanded in the Book.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Say: O people, fear God and associate not partners with Him, and think not evil thoughts, and slander not His chosen ones, and consume not the wealth of others, and commit not oppression and wickedness if ye be of those who are certain of God's decree in the Tree of His Cause.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: May you become the cause of comfort for your subjects and the source of the dawning of the light of guidance. May you serve the throne with perfect trustworthiness and sincerity, educate human souls, bestow spirituality upon hearts, and kindle such a flame with the fire of the love of God that its heat will affect the liver of the ether and its luminous flame become the Light of Sinai.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: O Feridun! Thy namesake did uproot the foundations of tyranny, and cleansed the realm of foes; he raised aloft the standard of Kavian, and laid the groundwork of justice. He nurtured the priests and exalted the peasants; he was a refuge to the helpless and a loving, compassionate friend to the distressed. Do thou likewise, according to thine own measure, follow the path of the righteous ones of old.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: The loved ones of God must appear before all people adorned with the ornament of trustworthiness, truthfulness and purity, and must strive with all their might to foster the unity of hearts and fellowship of souls.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: The friends of God must, with wisdom and utterance, deliver the oppressed servants from the claws of these oppressors. Blessed is the soul who hath firmly girded up the loins of endeavor for this service - such a one is recorded and mentioned in the Book of Names as being of the people of Baha....

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Those souls who today are sheltered beneath the shade of the Divine Word must first consider in all matters what benefits the Cause of God, and then attend to their own interests, so that the foundation may be established firm and solid.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Strive to attain nearness to reality through the acquisition of strength of character, through morality, through good works and helping the poor, through being consumed with the fire of the love of God and in discovering each day new spiritual mysteries. This is the path of intimate approach.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Counsel the servants to trustworthiness and godliness, and to that whereby the Word of God may be exalted amongst His servants. Verily thy Lord is the True Counsellor, there is none other God but Him, the Single, the One, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. Hold thou fast in all conditions unto the wisdom that hath been sent down in the Book, a command from God, the Sovereign of the Kingdom.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: O Salman! Hearken unto the Call from this Tree upraised in truth - verily there is none other God but Him, the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Bountiful. Counsel the servants regarding trustworthiness and truthfulness, and to act according to what hath been revealed in the Tablets. He who casteth away trustworthiness is among the most contemptible of creatures. To this testifieth He with Whom is the knowledge of the Book. Say: O people! Adorn yourselves with the attributes of the All-Merciful in the realm of possibility. Beware lest ye follow your passions.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: O My loved ones in that land! We counsel you to observe justice and equity, trustworthiness and religiosity, chastity and faithfulness. Your Lord, the All-Merciful, is verily the Expositor, the Mighty, the Loving. He created you, sustained you, assisted you in His Cause, and acquainted you with that which remained hidden from most of the learned. He counseleth you with that which shall profit you in all His worlds.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: He counseleth you with that which draweth you nigh unto God, the Lord of all worlds - with trustworthiness, religious devotion, chastity and fidelity, and with that through which the essence of justice may be made manifest in the contingent world.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Say: It behooveth you to adorn yourselves with My attributes, that My qualities may be manifested through you among My servants. Thus have ye been commanded by One All-Knowing, All-Informed.
Adorn yourselves with the ornament of trustworthiness among all people, that through it God's sanctification may be made manifest in all else.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: Say: O people! Follow not your vain imaginings, nor take the property of others wrongfully, nor dispute with anyone.
Be emblems of guidance among all creatures and manifestations of the favors of your Lord, the Kind, the Merciful.

order.why: Bring spiritual qualities into relations of trust, work, material obligations and the protection of others.
shortened: We have counseled all to be trustworthy, truthful and faithful, and to manifest those qualities through which the Cause of God was revealed in former ages. Blessed is he who hath heard and acted, and woe unto the heedless.

order.why: Open the movement on strength with courage expressed in peace, reconciliation and mastery of self.
shortened: Today the courageous one, like a ray of light, becomes the cause of illumination of regions and localities, and the enlightenment of the world and radiance of creation lie in peace and reconciliation, and success and prosperity. As much as you can, be a cultivator of peace and a fruitful and productive tree. Therefore, seek the wellbeing of all the people of the world and the comfort and security of humanity. Lay the foundation of love and faithfulness and uproot the edifice of discord and cruelty. Practice friendship and truthfulness and seek peace and reconciliation. Be kind to all creation and solicitous of friends.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Counsel all the friends to patience, calm and dignity, and say: O friends of God in the earth! Ye are honored in all the divine worlds through the name of the True One, but in this transient world which will end more quickly than aught else, ye have been afflicted with abasement. In the path of the one true God ye have heard taunts and witnessed tribulation, ye have been imprisoned and have laid down your lives, but because of the tyranny of a few heedless ones, ye must not transgress the bounds of God -- that is, ye must not molest any soul.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: In any case, if that oppressor showed cruelty, you show faithfulness; if he transgressed, you seek devotion. Extinguish the fire of that enmity with the water of love, and make patience and forbearance your shield against that sharp sword. As much as you can, show kindness and seek divine mercy, and demonstrate the utmost consideration and care.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Shed not blood, neither commit that which your hearts approve not, nor can reason accept. Purify your hearts from all earthly suggestions, that the revelation of your Lord, the All-Merciful, may be reflected therein. This is better for you than all that was and all that shall be.
Read ye the verses of God at eventide and at dawn.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: We counsel thee and My loved ones in that land to be patient and forbearing, and to manifest that whereby the signs of justice may be revealed amongst the servants. Verily, thy Lord is the All-Patient, the All-Forbearing.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: You must make firm the feet at the time when these trials transpire, and demonstrate forbearance and patience. You must withstand them with the utmost love and kindness; consider their oppression and persecution as the caprice of children, and do not give any importance to whatever they do.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Today everyone must follow God's command and nothing contrary to wisdom should proceed from him. In such case, should the manifestations of tyranny and wickedness arise to shed his blood, no harm shall come to pass, for it will have occurred in the path of God, and every soul shall taste of the cup of death. And if this inevitable decree occurs for the sake of God, it is surely better and more beloved.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Verily in the morning We sent down an epistle unto him who previously confirmed thy Lord's Cause, saying: Stand firm in that land and reform the deeds of those who spread corruption therein while claiming "We are the reformers."
Say: O Yahya, recite unto him what God hath permitted thee and kindle him with thy Lord's fire, and fear not, for truly the Messengers fear not before Me.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Say: O people! Have mercy upon yourselves and upon the Soul of God that standeth over all things. If ye believe not, oppose Him not. Beware, O people! Fear ye God in His Cause, and cut not off the wafting of the breezes of grace from the right hand of glory and praise. Purify your ears that ye may hear what proceedeth from the mouth of God, your Lord, that perchance the breathings of the Spirit may transform you and draw you nigh unto the station of God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Witnessed.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: Praise be to the Lord of all being, Who hath forbidden His loved ones from corruption, conflict and contention, and kept them sanctified therefrom. Happy and blessed are they, for they have acted in accordance with that from which the Light of truthfulness and reformation hath shone forth resplendent. They have hearkened with their inner ears to divine counsels and have not permitted transgression thereof.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: According to the Command, all friends must hold fast to patience and perseverance and keep their gaze fixed upon the horizons of divine ordinances. God, exalted be His glory, alone will grant victory and suffice against the evil of the oppressors. The victory of the friends has been and is spiritual qualities and pure, holy deeds.

order.why: Read firmness through the sources’ explicit calls to nonviolence, patience, reconciliation and restraint.
shortened: We have forbidden all corruption, strife, contention and unseemly deeds, and have commanded that which God loveth. These matters are evident and clear to all. Nevertheless, the Name of God and His loved ones remain imprisoned in the prison of the oppressors. There hath befallen them that which hath caused the Supreme Paradise and the Most Exalted Heaven to weep.

order.why: Begin the inquiry into learning with noble thought and release from blind imitation.
shortened: Strive to have noble thoughts and sublime aspirations; endeavour to raise the minds of people and release them from this darkness of blind imitation.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: And now, O seeker, it behooveth us firmly to cling unto the 'Urvatu'l-Vuthqa, that perchance we may leave behind the darksome night of error, and embrace the dawning light of divine guidance. Shall we not flee from the face of denial, and seek the sheltering shadow of certitude? Shall we not free ourselves from the horror of satanic gloom, and hasten towards the rising light of the heavenly Beauty?

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Thus sayeth He, blessed and exalted be He: "O friends of God in His earth, His chosen ones in His lands, and His party among His creatures! Purify your hearts from the stories of the past, through attachment to which the feet of the people of the past have slipped, those who prided themselves over the world and all peoples."

order.why: Read the different meanings of the Book and the stated purpose of guidance, without collapsing the distinctions the source makes.
shortened: Their purpose hath been and still is the guidance of mankind. Whatsoever is the cause of preservation of the servants and the exaltation of their stations is recorded in the Books. Blessed are they that understand and that act accordingly!

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Divine counsels are a spiritual feast sent down from the heaven of the All-Merciful Will. The friends must appreciate the value of this everlasting bounty and not lose this most great favor and most perfect grace through the conjectures of transient souls.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: O ye heedless ones, become mindful! O ye sleeping ones, be awakened! O ye blind ones, become seeing! O ye deaf ones, become hearing! O ye dumb ones, become speakers! O ye dead ones, become living! O ye deprived ones, take a portion! This is the effulgence of the Merciful and the moving of the Depthless Sea.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Draw them through the influence of Thine utterances unto the Dawning-Place of Thine inspiration, and to the Fountain of Thy Revelation, and to the Treasury of Thy wisdom.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Ponder, O people, then read what We have sent down in truth. Verily it guideth you unto My Straight Path. Hold fast unto the cord of your Lord's loving-kindness and abandon that which ye were commanded by every ignorant doubter.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: If you desire a goodly life, scatter the seeds of wisdom in pure and goodly soil, that each grain may grow for you into seven green and blessed ears of corn. If you intend to build in the realm of contingent being, raise a glorious edifice with firm pillars, its foundation fixed at the central attractive point in the lowest depth and its highest chambers in the supreme zenith of the ether.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: O divine friends! With heart and soul desire and seek confirmation from the All-Forgiving Lord, that each of you may become a brilliant star in the horizon of guidance, and a fruit-bearing tree in the Abha Paradise, and a bright lamp in the gathering of spiritual ones, and an ornament to the assembly in the gathering of the All-Merciful ones.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: In truth, those regions have the utmost capacity, but souls are needed who will shine like candles in that niche and breathe the spirit of life into souls, guiding them to the path of guidance, so that divine inspirations may become manifest from human realities.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: It is time for the friends to free themselves from every thought and occupy themselves with guiding the seekers and directing the lost. If they do this, the rays of the manifest light will, in a brief time, illuminate and brighten the face of the earth.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Remind thou the people of this Tablet and acquaint them with what God hath intended for them in the Book. We have sent down these verses unto thee that thou mayest recite them to those who have turned unto God, the Revealer of Books and the Manifestor of proof, that they may act upon what is contained therein and hold fast unto that which they have been commanded in the Tablets.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: O thou truthful servant of the Ancient Beauty!
Let thy mind be alert, thy heart alive. Be like a tidal wave in the sea of God's love that thou mayest cast ashore the pearls of truth and inner significance.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: My object in taking that long journey through the West- was to awaken them out of this sleep; that they may not grovel all the time in the world of matter and that they may not only think of eating and drinking.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: It was beautiful to see how 'Abdu'l-Baha did not emphatically deny their assertions, but gave to understand that much of it was imagination.

order.why: Consider how receptivity, knowledge and independent thought prepare a person to act upon counsel.
shortened: Strive that from thee may appear a deed that shall enter and be preserved in the treasury of divine acceptance.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: If you succeed in this, they will become laughing hundred-petaled roses in the divine rose garden, swaying cypresses by the divine stream, growing and flourishing in the spiritual garden, putting forth leaves and blossoms, bearing fresh fruit, and becoming the adornment of the highest paradise.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: In brief, the hope of 'Abdu'l-Baha is this: that the descendents will bring glory to their predecessors, and that the sons will cause the garden of their fathers' hopes to flourish.

order.why: Keep the school setting and the full reported address before drawing implications for education.
shortened: You are the children of the new time. Your thoughts should always be as to how you may become wise and good. You should seek sagacity and prudence, and to make progress in the right path.

order.why: Preserve this advice to a particular young man about study and a profession; do not convert it into a universal prohibition of recreation.
shortened: He does not fretter away his time in idle pastimes and unprofitable pursuits.

There is an Arabic proverb which says: 'A dancer starts his performance by the slow motion of his shoulders, then little by little brings into poetic vibrations all the rest of his body.' Similarly a young man desiring to lay a good foundation for his later life must devote his first few years to the study of his chosen profession and forget all pleasures and sports which divert him from accomplishing his main purpose. This is success and prosperity.

order.why: Retain the personal choice and permitted service alongside encouragement in knowledge, calligraphy and character.
shortened: We sent Munirih - the choice is yours. We gave permission for fifteen days of service. O leaf! The Tree commands: do not fall short in knowledge, calligraphy and character.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: O youth! God willing, through the bounties of the All-Merciful thou shalt be favored with His infinite divine outpourings. As thou hast been adorned in early youth with the recognition of the Dawning-Place of Revelation, beseech God that thou mayest be assisted in that which shall endure and remain permanent in the Book of the world.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: And although they show perfect diligence and attention in service to Arbab Bahman, they must show even greater effort and demonstrate extreme zeal and dedication, for Arbab Bahman is truly good-natured and kind. They must show him consideration in all respects, for faithfulness to him is service to the Truth.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Since you are the descendant of that glorious one, you must follow his example and traverse the stages of servitude, engaging in service with heart and soul, sacrificing yourself, being joyous and successful, so that you too may become a sign of the All-Merciful at life's end and enter the divine world.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Act in such wise that you may shine forth in the Kingdom of God and adorn your countenance with the light of Baha and the radiance of the Covenant. Physical splendor lasteth but a moment, and the ocean of joy in this earthly realm is but a dewdrop. Show forth a lofty aspiration and be not content with a moment or a dewdrop.

order.why: Retain the surrounding distinction and relationship between medical and spiritual treatment.
shortened: Now, if thou wishest to know the true remedy which will heal man from all sickness and will give him the health of the divine kingdom, know that it is the precepts and teachings of God. Focus thine attention upon them.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Continue attending to affairs with the utmost joy, delight and greatest gladness. We beseech God to assist you in completing your tasks. You have truly undergone hardship, but arise to set matters right with perfect steadfastness.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Therefore I hope that through the aid of the Lord you will keep his lamp burning, water his cultivation, and nurture his sapling - nay, that you will be enabled to achieve even greater things, for his name was Rida-Quli while yours is Husayn-Quli. In any case, strive to fill his cup to overflowing and become the joy of the righteous ones.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: O maidservant of God! I hope that through the grace and bounty of the Intended Lord and the Sovereign of the unseen and seen, He will raise up women who will be manifest signs of this Most Great Revelation and evident standards among the nations.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Therefore, his honored descendants must shine forth like stars from the dawning-place of divine favors. Each one must strive and arise so that this effulgent light may grow brighter day by day, and the radiance and beams of this star of sanctity may become more evident and manifest, and his eternal glory more clear and apparent.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: O handmaiden of God! Thy letter was received. The doors of the Kingdom are opened and the divine bounty is like the spring rain. Although the signs of material bounty are great, yet the true bounty is that of heaven, which bestows eternal life. Follow this and thy heart will become as beautiful as a garden, thine eyes illumined, thy spirit joyous and thy thoughts a comfort to souls.

order.why: Keep the personal marital circumstances and source authority visible; do not recast this letter as a universal instruction for every relationship.
Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Now you must return to that glorious tribe, associate with the khans, seek eternal glory for them, and befriend them with conduct befitting the people of Baha, so that you may educate them with divine education and raise them from the lowest depths to the highest heights.

order.why: Keep this counsel in its address to a prince and its particular political setting.
shortened: Thereupon shall every difficulty be dissolved, every hope be fulfilled, souls be educated, the morals of all men be refined, minds advance, and chastity and the love of goodness be firmly established in hearts made mindful through the remembrance of God; and the divine fragrances shall perfume every country and every land. Wherefore, cleave thou unto the way of Christ and walk in His spacious field, and follow the people of God in every age and clime. As to political affairs, they are but transient and partial matters, yielding neither fruit nor true advantage; no man who hath tasted the sweetness of the love of God will busy himself therewith.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Keep the counsels of the Wronged One before your eyes, for whatsoever has been and is spoken is and shall be pure good. Hold fast to the Sure Handle and cling to the hem of the grace of the Lord of Names, and say:

O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Name and Thy sovereignty and the power that has encompassed those in Thy earth and heaven, to make me in all conditions one who gazes upon Thy Throne whereon is established the Temple of Thy Cause and the Dawning-Place of Thy Revelation.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: O my handmaiden! Rejoice in My mention, for it is better for thee than every deed and every wise command. Beware lest the veils of women hold thee back from the Lord of Names, or the deeds of the idolaters frighten thee from this clear announcement.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: Strive ye, that through the name of the Beloved of the World, ye may preserve the pearls of the love of the Ancient Lord in the treasuries of hearts from thieves and robbers. This is the counsel of this Wronged One unto His leaves and handmaidens.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: In the acquisition of perfection, negligence is not permissible. Exert thy utmost endeavor.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: I counsel thee to be patient and tranquil, and to observe that which God hath revealed in His Book. Circle round the will of My Afnan, upon whom be My glory and My mercy and My loving-kindness, then follow what he commandeth thee.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: The relatives, both men and women, must not delay for an instant in acquiring perfection. Thus have We counseled before and in this Manifest Tablet.

order.why: Keep guidance to children, families and named recipients within its particular relationships and circumstances.
shortened: O My Afnan! Be thou speaking in My praise, gazing toward My horizon, turning unto My face, and standing firm in the service of My wondrous Cause. We have counseled thee with that which shall be a lamp unto thee in the worlds of thy Lord.

order.why: Open the movement on wisdom with the invitation to find a station between slowness and haste.
shortened: O people of Baha! Choose for yourselves a station between slowness and haste. Thus doth command you the Goal of all seekers, in Whose grasp lie the kingdoms of the heavens and earth.

order.why: Connect the pace of action with consideration of its eventual consequences.
shortened: When you consider the end results of things, reality will become evident and the outcome clear and manifest. In matters one must not look at the beginning - consideration of the end is necessary.

order.why: Preserve the condition about preparedness and capacity before the instruction to act.
shortened: Under all conditions they must hold fast to the cord of wisdom. If a land is cultivated and achieves capacity, planting therein becomes necessary, and this is among those deeds which have been and are great in the sight of God. Otherwise, no. O my beloved! The cawing of the ignorant has prevented the people from the choice wine of the utterance of the Lord of Names.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: In all circumstances hold fast to wisdom and cleave thereunto. The gatherings of friends, when they exceed the bounds of moderation, will become a cause of agitation among souls, for until this time the people of the earth, their divines, and their rulers have not been informed of the purpose of God, exalted be His glory.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: Wisdom is a light that illuminates the world of knowledge. The friends must at all times observe wisdom and drink from its fountainhead. With utmost forbearance and through goodly utterances, they should lead people from the left hand of doubt to the right hand of certitude.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: We counsel thee to observe wisdom lest there occur that which God abhorreth and the clamor of them that have denied the Day of Judgment be raised. Hold thou fast unto the cord of wisdom in all circumstances. Verily He witnesseth and seeth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. Beware lest the affairs of men grieve thee.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: In all circumstances, keep thine eye upon wisdom. This is among the binding counsels of God which hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen in most of the Tablets.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: O friends! Hold fast unto wisdom and unto that which God hath chosen. Act in accordance with that which draweth nigh the servants and causeth the dwellers of all lands to be attracted. This is the divine counsel whose light hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of grace. Blessed is he who hath witnessed and seen, and woe unto the heedless!

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: God willing, ye must be the dawning-places of divine counsels among mankind, that through your advice the heedless may turn to the ocean of certitude and the manifest horizon.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: At all times ye must remind the people of that city of the divine verses with perfect wisdom, that perchance the darkness of the vain imaginings of heedless souls may not prevent the friends from the splendors of the rays of the Sun of Truth.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: All are commanded today to observe wisdom, and this firm divine decree hath been revealed in most of the Tablets, for lack of wisdom hath been and shall be the cause of commotion among the people and the perturbation of souls.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: That which is necessary today has been and will be to act according to the divine ordinances. One must summon the people to the highest horizon with the utmost wisdom and to act according to what hath been sent down in the Book.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: Regarding your own duties that you had asked about - your duty is that in the land of Ya [Yazd] with utmost detachment, attraction, enthusiasm, calmness and dignity you should associate and gather with the loved ones of God. And if you observe two people between whom there is any dust [of disagreement], through whatever means possible create harmony between them. Similarly, move with perfect wisdom and guide the loved ones to wisdom and tolerance, lest people become alarmed and agitated due to lack of wisdom.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: We have enjoined upon Our loved ones wisdom and utterance, the reformation of the world and the refinement of the souls of nations. Blessed is he who hath heard My call, and woe betide every froward denier. Thus have We lit the lamp of utterance in the niche of knowledge. Blessed is he who hath attained, and woe betide every heedless doubter.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: O friends! Reflect upon the proof of the All-Merciful and deprive not yourselves of the eternal realms for the sake of ephemeral days. Cling ye to the cord of the Cause with such firmness that the entire world shall be powerless to separate you from it.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: Convey My greetings to the faces of My loved ones and remind them of My Cause and what hath appeared in My days, lest the conditions of the powerful ones who have turned away from God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, weaken them. Hold fast unto the cord of wisdom in all circumstances, lest there appear that which would sadden the hearts of those who have turned towards God.

order.why: Consider timing, capacity, moderation and the manner of communicating a conviction.
shortened: Strive thou that in the days of God thou mayest act in a manner befitting and meet - that is, that ye may act according to that which hath been revealed in the Book of God and which causeth not the clamor of the people - so that the fragrance of holiness may be wafted from thee.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: With the utmost friendliness and in a spirit of perfect fellowship take ye counsel together, and dedicate the precious days of your lives to the betterment of the world and the promotion of the Cause of Him Who is the Ancient and Sovereign Lord of all. He, verily, enjoineth upon all men what is right, and forbiddeth whatsoever degradeth their station.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: Arise and, armed with the power of faith, shatter to pieces the gods of your vain imaginings, the sowers of dissension amongst you. Cleave unto that which draweth you together and uniteth you. This, verily, is the most exalted Word which the Mother Book hath sent down and revealed unto you.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: O loved ones of God! If you desire the joy and gladness, the repose of spirit and peace of conscience of 'Abdu'l-Baha, add to your unity and concord. Be as the waves of one sea, the drops of one river, the flowers of one rose garden, and the links of one coat of mail. Soar in one atmosphere and sing in one melody and voice. This is the cause of eternal joy and the comfort of the heart in the everlasting world.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Now is the time for you to gird up the loins of endeavor and uproot this discord from among the friends.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: The friends of God must gird up their loins to serve and become the cause of fellowship and unity of hearts and souls, and in all conditions be mindful of wisdom.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: Beware lest ye commit that which would cause sedition. Be united in the Cause and be not of those who differ.
Beware lest ye differ in God's Cause and follow the imaginings of the doubters.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: Be united in the love of God and the Manifestation of His Cause. Beware lest ye differ in aught. Thus have ye been commanded by One Who is the Mighty, the All-Wise.

Remember God at all times, be not heedless of Him, and be not of the negligent. Verily, this Youth of God is among you, Who hath come to you with clear authority, Who forbiddeth you from tyranny and wickedness and commandeth you to righteousness and godliness.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: Now I counsel all that, God willing, they may hereafter move in perfect unity and remain steadfast in the Cause, discerning with insight between truth and falsehood, for truth is as manifest from falsehood as the radiant morn from the dark night. Let them not cling to their own suppositions.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: That honored one and the company of the fair-minded bear witness that this Wronged One hath at all times enjoined upon the peoples of the earth in general such counsels and wisdom as would extinguish the fire of hatred and sedition, conflict and corruption; and particularly hath given to the people of Baha counsels which, were they to be cast upon the rock, it would cry out and proclaim; and were they to be cast upon the earth, it would be stirred in attraction and circle round; and were they to be cast toward the heaven, it would be moved and would exclaim: "O people of creation! Be fair in the cause of God, then consider what hath appeared in truth.

order.why: Trace the movement from inward freedom from division toward active reconciliation and shared purpose.
shortened: We beseech God to set right the affairs of the Siyyids and We command them to unity and love and to that which God hath revealed in the Book. In this case they will surely witness that which will bring forth joy and gladness and delight and exultation, and all will be made happy.

order.why: Read the Báb’s counsel to the people of the Bayán in relation to recognition of Him Whom God shall make manifest.
shortened: Therefore fear ye, O people of the Bayan, for by this shall you be tested, and through your allegiance to Him Whom God shall make manifest shall you be delivered. Be not veiled by your circumstances, for all glory belongeth unto God and unto Him Whom God shall make manifest, if ye but knew.

order.why: Retain the connection between unity among the people of the Bayán and their responsibility toward the promised Manifestation.
shortened: O people of the Bayan! Don ye the shirt of wisdom! O people of the Bayan! Put on the robe of unity! For differences in your ranks return unto Him Whom God shall make manifest in such wise as to grieve Him. Therefore, fear ye God and differ not in any command or prohibition.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Say: First, detach yourselves from all things, then secondly believe in your Lord. And if ye do not do this, then at least feel shame. If ye cannot make Him happy, at least grieve Him not. This is the whole of your cause, this is the whole of your religion, this is all that would please you.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Say: O people! Fear God and pervert not the Word from its place - this is it, were you but fair-minded.
Say: O people! Have mercy on yourselves and break not God's covenant and testament. This is sincere counsel, were you but hearing.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Choose ye nothing for yourselves except that ye desire it for God, the Lord of the worlds. Do no deed except that ye act sincerely for God, the Lord of the worlds. Hearken not to any word except that ye hearken through God, for God, the Lord of the worlds. Look not upon anything except that ye look through God, for God, the Lord of the worlds.

order.why: Keep the fasting instruction with its source’s exemptions for illness and travel.
shortened: Restrain yourselves from sunrise to sunset. Thus doth the Beloved of mankind instruct you as bidden by God, the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained. It is not for anyone to exceed the limits laid down by God and His law, nor should anyone follow his own idle imaginings. Well is it with the one who fulfilleth My decrees for the love of My Beauty, and woe to the one who neglecteth the Dayspring of Command in the days of his Lord, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Grieve not at the thoughts of the deniers in your presence, but rely upon God, your Lord. Verily He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing in truth, and your Lord has power over all things.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O party of God! Fear God and follow not your desires. Follow what hath been sent down from the heaven of Command in My perspicuous Book. We have counseled you, and do counsel you, with that which will exalt the Cause of God and your stations.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: In any case, thou must continually guide the loved ones of God to be firm and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament, so that when the waves of doubts crash against the mighty barrier of certitude, they are turned back and drown those same followers of ambiguous words.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: This servant hopes that through the power of thy steadfastness every wavering one may become firm and every vain soul disappointed. May all return to the Covenant and Testament and become mindful of falling into loss.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Strive, therefore, in this world that thy purpose may be that which God hath purposed for thee, for that which He hath purposed should be the purpose of every soul. Choose not for thyself save that which He hath chosen for thee and commanded thee, for He is the Unconstrained, and hath chosen what His righteous servants, they that are among the most virtuous, have chosen.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Therefore must the loved ones of God carry out His commandments with the utmost joy and fragrance, and shun that which He hath forbidden. This is the supreme counsel that hath issued forth from the Pen of the Lord of eternity.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: We counsel thee to be steadfast in this Cause, for through it the feet of them that have attained have slipped. Turn not unto the world and its affairs. In all matters place thy trust in God, the Single One, the All-Informed.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: It is incumbent upon all the friends of God to protect these helpless people lest they become again afflicted with the vain imaginings of the former party and remain deprived of the recognition of the Purpose.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O Rida! Be content with what God hath been pleased with, and be not one who doubteth His Cause.
Purify thyself from the allusions of the people, then thy breast from that which hindereth thee from this bounty which hath encompassed all the worlds.
Let not thy soul be troubled, and fear no one. Look unto God and what is with Him, not what is with thee.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Hold thou fast unto the cord of steadfastness in such wise that neither the affairs of men nor the veils of those who have disbelieved in God, the Mighty, the Beloved, may disturb thee.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Remind the people of this announcement which hath been sent down in the Tablets. Say: O people! When ye hear the call of the Calf, leave it behind you. This is what God hath counseled you, for verily He is witness to all things.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Choose ye for yourselves what God hath chosen for you.
Rejoice ye in My remembrance of you and arise to that which profiteth you in the world to come and in this first life.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Thus doth command thee He Who hath spoken that there is none other God but I, the One Who commandeth, the All-Wise. Say: O people, hold fast unto that which draweth you nigh unto God and profiteth you in all His worlds. He, verily, is the Counselor, the All-Knowing.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Say: O people! Follow not your passions, nor walk in the footsteps of them who have denied God, the Lord of the mighty Throne. Beware lest the world beguile you from God, the Creator of earth and heaven. Cast away what ye possess in your search for that which is with your Lord, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Say: Fear God and follow not your desires. Follow Him Who hath come to you with a manifest sovereignty. Beware lest the ornaments of the world withhold you from the Lord of Names. Leave behind what ye possess by command of God, the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: However, all must observe the divine ordinances. By My life! They will benefit you and will bring you to a station that cannot be described in words.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Hold fast unto the Book, then act according to that which hath been sent down therein from the Pen of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: We counsel thee and those who have believed to show forth such steadfastness as will cause the heaven of idle fancies to be cleft asunder, the earth of vain imaginings to be split open, and the mountain of the people's conceit to crumble.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Be thou steadfast in the Cause in such wise that the sincere ones may find in thee that which beseemeth the days of thy Lord, the All-Knowing. Preserve this most exalted station through the name of thy Lord, the Most Glorious.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Occupy thyself with the Kingdom as much as thou canst and forget all else save the True One; in order that thou mayest, day by day, find a new power in the Cause of God and gain a great stability.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O thou who hast acquired the light of guidance! Thy letter was received.
Look not at the creatures but rather turn thy gaze to the Creator of creation.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Therefore strive within yourselves to reach such station in your love that ye move not save by His leave, nor turn save unto the paths of His good-pleasure, nor speak save that which ye are commanded in His Book. Thus did We counsel you before and thus do We counsel you at this time of separation from the shores of Iraq.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Follow in all matters thy Lord, the Lord of Revelation, in such wise that nothing shall prevent thee from celebrating His praise amongst His servants. This is what God hath chosen for His chosen servants who sleep in His love and arise in His remembrance and move by His command and proclaim wisdom among His creatures.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: We counsel Our loved ones with that whereby the Cause of God and His sovereignty may be exalted. Beware lest ye abandon that which ye have been commanded by God, the Mighty, the All-Loving.
Say: Take ye what ye have been commanded and follow not those who have cast the laws of God behind their backs and followed every ignorant one who is rejected.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Be thou steadfast in this station in such wise that neither the doubts of men nor the allusions of the heedless shall cause thee to slip. Beware lest anything prevent thee from this most exalted station or any matter debar thee from this resplendent horizon.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
