shortened: Take ye, O My loved ones, the bounds and ordinances of God. Beware lest the intimations of such as have been heedless of God through following the promptings of self and desire debar you.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Therein doth God command you to practice righteousness and piety, and forbiddeth you from transgression and indecency, would that ye might understand.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O My loved ones! We counsel you to observe that which We have revealed in the Book. Hold fast unto it and be not of the heedless ones. Cast behind you the tales of old and cleave unto this Most Great Announcement.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Take hold of the Book of God with the power bestowed by Him, then act according to that which beseemeth His days. He, verily, is the True Counsellor, the Trustworthy. Be thou steadfast in that which is good and act in accordance with that which thou hast been commanded in the Book of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Hold fast with complete determination, lest diverse winds prevent thee. In all conditions, keep thy gaze fixed upon the Truth and remain detached and free from aught else.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: The souls who have accepted must hold fast to the divine Tablets and act according to whatsoever hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen in the Most Holy Book. This is a bounty whereunto nothing in the heavens and earth can be compared.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O people of Baha! Turn ye with all your being unto God and arise to serve the Cause with such strength of heart and resolve as to shake the mountains.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: Leave thou those who have denied the signs of God, and take hold, with the hand of submission, of My mighty Tablet. We have commanded all to that which profiteth them. Some have turned towards it and some have turned away, and he who turneth away is among the distracted ones.

order.why: Read commandments and fidelity in the distinct settings of the Báb’s and Bahá’u’lláh’s teachings and the Covenant.
shortened: O peoples of the earth! The Object of your desire hath appeared, and He, verily, is the One promised in the Scriptures of God, your Lord and the Lord of all worlds. Beware lest the ornaments of the world debar you from God, the Lord of all names. Cast them behind you, turning your faces toward the court of your Lord, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

order.why: Open the movement on adversity with remembrance accompanied by outward effort according to capacity.
shortened: Be thou occupied at all times with the remembrance of the All-Merciful, and strive in outward matters according to thy capacity. This is thy duty, and thy Lord, the All-Merciful, is the Ruler over what He willeth.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: Grieve not on account of Our adversity, but be patient even as We have been patient. He, in truth, is the best of helpers. Remember thy Lord in the daytime and in the night season, and extol His praise amidst His servants. Haply the fire of His love will thereby be kindled in the hearts of the righteous, and all shall arise in turn to extol God, their Lord, the Lord of the seen and the unseen, and the Lord of your sires of old.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: He is the One Who speaketh in the Kingdom of Utterance:

O Ali! Beseech God that He may draw thee to such a station wherein the clamor of men and the oppression of those in the land shall not prevent thee from Him. Today the limbs of the world are trembling and the tribes of the earth are quaking and disturbed. The recompense of the unseemly deeds of various peoples hath encompassed them.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: Know thou that protection lieth in God's hand - He protecteth whom He willeth through His sovereignty and none can avert that which is ordained.
Be thou at peace within thyself, then arise and say: "O people! The Beauty of Him Who was promised hath come with manifest sovereignty.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: O leaf! Great is this Day and mighty is this Cause. You must at all times turn to the All-Merciful in such wise that the intimations of deluded souls will not cause you to slip.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: We counsel thee to be steadfast and God-fearing in the Cause of God, the Lord of all mankind. Beware lest anything whatsoever debar thee from the Lord of Names or cause thee to tremble at the might of those who have denied the Day of Judgment.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: Let not the might of the world frighten thee, nor the utterances of any deluded one cause thee grief. Hold fast unto God in all conditions and cling to His luminous hem.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: In truth, steadfastness must be sought for the friends. This imperative divine Cause is, from one perspective, seen to be most easy, inasmuch as from the beginning that hath no beginning unto the end that hath no end, there hath not appeared, nor will there appear, treasures of utterance and knowledge like unto those that have been manifested in this Most Great Revelation.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: Today from the rustling of the breezes of the gardens of utterance this word is heard: "O people of Baha! Look not upon the creatures and their clamor and oppression, but rather upon the Truth and His justice and sovereignty."

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: If others are caught in the sleep of heedlessness, you must become awakened and day and night seek forgiveness and beg pardon for sins. He says "Verily God loves those who turn in repentance" and likewise He says "Guard against an affliction that will not strike only those among you who have done wrong."

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: O handmaid of God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting!
Do not imagine that you have been forgotten or that we have ceased to mention you.
The exigencies of the time and wisdom required that all should not be fettered.
Indeed separation from the Holy Land was difficult for you, but one must be patient and forbearing. Besides submission and contentment what [choice is there]?

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: Therefore the friends must supplicate to the Abha Kingdom and seek confirmation and success for Abdul-Baha, for the being is weak and the burden is heavy.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: That which you had written was heard. God willing, the waters of the world shall not prevent you from the Kawthar of God, and gold shall not make you heedless of the divine path. We beseech God, the Lord of the Throne and earth, the Master of the hereafter and the former times, to assist His loved ones, His friends, and His chosen ones in that whereby the standards of guidance may be raised among all creation and the banners of proof and evidence upon the hills of contingent being.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: O My loved ones! Hold fast to that which will exalt the Cause of God, then shun that which you have been forbidden in the Book of your Lord, the Evident, the All-Informed. Be not grieved at anything, for He is with you and ordains for you that which will profit you in this world and the next.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: I counsel thee to fear God Who created thee by His command and made thee to be of the guided ones. Be patient in all that hath befallen Us and be not dismayed by anything. Therefore, be patient in thyself and be of the patient ones.

order.why: Keep the language of perseverance, consolation and trust connected with the difficulties and relationships named in each source.
shortened: This Wronged One makes mention of the friends of God in all conditions and commands them to perform goodly deeds, manifest praiseworthy conduct, and fear God. His purpose has been and continues to be the exaltation of the Word of Unity.

order.why: Restore the preceding question about service before the reported answer.
shortened: A.B. My admonition to you is this. Be thoughtful of attaining to that which was the utmost desire of the Saints. Strive with all your heart and soul to attain to the Kingdom of God. This is my wish for you.

order.why: Restore the request to be taught the true way before the reply about the difficulty of remaining steadfast.
shortened: Abdu'l-Baha:

Is there any greater desire than this? It is a big desire. This desire cannot be compared to all others. It is hard to be steadfast, to follow the straight path -- there is nothing harder. There are many who take ten steps in this path, some travel ten miles, are tired, and then stop.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Today is the Day to render victorious the Cause of God. It is incumbent upon every soul to summon the people to the divine realm with the utmost steadfastness. Make ye a mighty effort, so that perchance those who have strayed in the wilderness of self and passion may turn their faces toward the most holy and glorious horizon. From souls will come forth effects that are and ever shall be cherished, for the fruit of every soul is its effect. A soul without effect is, in the Most Sublime Vision, accounted as a tree without fruit.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Gird up the loins of endeavour, and step into the circle of the angels of the paradise of Oneness. Thus may ye, on the shores of the Most Great Ocean, net the fish that thirst for the seas of divine knowledge and, in the fields of unity, catch the gazelles that seek the meads of reality, so that through the unfailing aid and bounty of the Lord, ye may gather together all nations beneath the shade of the Word of Oneness.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: It is hoped that, through the bounties of the All-Glorious Lord, thou wilt achieve even greater success than before, wilt cheer all the friends through distinguished services, and wilt, at all times, arise as an obedient servant to render service to the loved ones of God, for service to the loved ones of God is service to God. Glory be upon all who stand firm in the Covenant of God.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Gather then together the believers in that land round the all-embracing Word, the luminous bounty, the manifest sign, and the glorious banner of the Book of God and His Faith, so that they may be revived and refreshed through the breaths of this supreme bestowal, and may be so set ablaze with the immortal flame kindled in the sacred Tree that each may become a kindled torch, a shining orb, and a brilliant star.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Stand ye firm in the Cause of God in such wise that every wavering one may become steadfast and every mouldering bone may be set in motion. Strive ye that the darkness of contingent being may be illumined by the lights of the mention of the All-Merciful. God willing, may ye all arise to that which befits your stations and your relationship to God.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O Salman! Inform My servants not to spread corruption in the earth. Say: Hold fast to the cord of servitude, for through it God's Cause shall be made manifest, your influence shall be exalted among the servants, and the countenance of every sincere seeker shall be illumined. Then know, O Salman, that We desire from Our servants naught but that they speak with pure truthfulness and transgress not the bounds of justice.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: They must not rest a moment nor take a breath of ease. Nay, rather, night and day must they be striving, working and serving! And with perfect severance, spirituality and the best intent and effort must they hasten to promulgate the Divine Teaching, and above all they must act according to the precepts and exhortations of His Holiness Baha'u'llah, for in this cycle of Baha'u'llah verbal confessions and acknowledgements, literal faith and certainty and external relations are of no avail.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Therefore, O thou who art firm in the Covenant, strive and make an effort and show determination so that thou mayest be among those who outstrip others in good deeds and become a manifestation of the gifts of the Lord of dazzling signs, becoming a bright star, and with the lights of humility, submissiveness, lowliness, supplication and detachment, make this transient world a mirror of the eternal realm.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O dove of the gardens of grace! It is time for singing, warbling and melodies, and the season for kindling the fire of the love of God. If in this Most Great Cycle, which shines bright like the sun among all other cycles, one remains silent and stunned, in what cycle will they become eloquent, speaking and explaining?

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Therefore I hope that you will arise to exalt the Word of God, for today the hosts of divine confirmation and success are rushing forth and awaiting the arising of sincere souls. Whoever arises will be victorious and triumphant.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: When I love people I do not tell them to their faces. You know how much I love Mirza-Abul-Fazl and Haji-Mirza-Heydar-Ali, but I have seldom told them to their faces.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Pay no attention - stay focused on your work.
Hold general meetings in your home and give eloquent talks with complete courage, and be assured that the breaths of the Holy Spirit will assist you and you will be victorious.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Why are you silent? Why are you quiet? Why are you sad? Why are you grieved? We who are servants at the threshold of the Beloved of the horizons - our joy and delight come from the exaltation of God's Cause, not from nightly drinking and the sound of harp and flute and drunken inclinations and emotions.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Strive as much as thou canst to manifest thyself in the world of existence and the realm of visibility with the utmost spiritual freshness, inner delicacy and luminous vigor, and to be stirred by the breezes from the garden of the Covenant.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: My hope is that you may, by the aid of God, be enabled to remove the veils from the eyes of the wayward and to cleanse the minds of the malevolent.

Visit, on your way, Isfahan, Kashan, Tihran, and Khurasan. Proceed thence to Iraq, and there await the summons of your Lord, who will keep watch over you and will direct you to whatsoever is His will and desire.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Hearken thou unto My counsel, and unto that which the Tongue of God doth utter in this wondrous Age. Beware lest anything deter thee or any matter hinder thee. Strive within thyself, then endeavor in thine essence, that thou mayest be numbered among the righteous in this Cause, whereby the people of the realms of mystical insight are terrified, and the dwellers of the pavilions of certitude are dismayed, and the spirits of them that are nigh unto God are thunderstruck, and the mountain of the arrogant is crushed.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Convey the Cause of thy Lord with wisdom and utterance, then protect the servants from the arrows of those who have disbelieved in God, the Sovereign of existence. Be a servant of thy Lord's Cause and a guardian of the City of the Bayan, lest there enter it any immoral one who hath turned away from God, the Mighty, the Loving.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Be thou articulate in His remembrance and steadfast in His service in such wise that neither the veils of the world nor the allusions of them who have disbelieved in God, the Mighty, the Loving, shall hold thee back.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Thy Lord is, in truth, the All-Hearing, the Answering. Stand firm in the Cause through the power of thy Lord and remind the people with wisdom and utterance. He is, verily, the One Who commandeth in truth, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Beware lest the affairs of men hold thee back from the truth. Leave the world behind and take what God hath sent down in His mighty Book.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Beware lest the veils of the world and its manifestations and colors prevent you. Arise to promote the Cause with complete dedication and great steadfastness, and summon humanity unto truth through wisdom and utterance.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Show ye an effort!  Work unceasingly.  Labor diligently;- so that the everlasting Bounty be realized, Eternal life be destined and the nostrils be perfumed with the holy Fragrances.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Put ye forth-extraordinary exertion by day and by night; so that ye may conduct yourselves in accord with the Divine Teachings; grant salubrious water to the thirsty ones and be the balm of heart and the healing of the spirit to the sick ones in both worlds.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O gentle branch of the Blessed Tree! For some time no letter has arrived and no fresh breeze has blown. Is laziness the cause, or coldness? If so, this is the utmost shame, for laziness and coldness cannot coexist with the warmth of the love of God. Until one burns, one cannot become a candle.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Therefore, guide everyone day and night to that which brings comfort to 'Abdu'l-Baha's heart, and lead them through blessed character and conduct. Be a divine counselor and guide to the path of spiritual joy and delight.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Raise thou this call as much as thou canst, and sound and blow this clarion continually night and day, so that the souls may become quickened and the people find eternal life.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O thou my kind friend!

I have the utmost love for thee and I ask God that thou mayest become assisted in the world and in the Kingdom and precede Paul and Peter in spreading the Word of God and diffusing the fragrances of God and become a manifest ensign in the regions of America.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Stretch thy hand from thy sleeve and scatter the treasure of the spirit throughout the regions of the world. Put thy tongue and utterance to use in promoting the religion of God and exalting the Word of God, that thou mayest, like unto a polished sword, conquer territories and, like unto the morning breeze, bestow fresh life upon yearning hearts.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O my beloved! Arise from thy couch, stand up from thy resting place, and strive with utmost endeavor and consummate wisdom which cannot be surpassed to spread the divine fragrances until the horizons are perfumed and heedlessness and hypocrisy vanish.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: May you be of those who have believed and obeyed; may you be of the few that are chosen rather than of the many that are called!

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: O Ahmad! Arise to that which will cause the exaltation of the Word of God, and with complete humility speak His praise. Verily, He maketh mention of him who maketh mention of Him, and ordaineth for him what beseemeth His glorious and wondrous bounty.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Fix in thy heart that which the Tongue of Grandeur and Majesty hath spoken, then make mention of it and be not of them that remain silent.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Be as standards upon the hills among the servants - this behooveth you, did ye but know. Be horizons of guidance among all creatures, such that all may receive blessings from your breaths and be illumined by the lamp of your utterance.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Thou must, with the utmost striving and endeavor, and with wisdom and utterance, engage in spreading the divine mention and verses. Verily He will assist thee and manifest for thee what hath been ordained for thee.

order.why: Develop the outward expression of counsel in teaching, mutual service and sustained effort.
shortened: Blessed is the soul that ariseth today with complete sincerity and becometh adorned with that which guideth mankind and speaketh thereof.

order.why: Begin the reflection on time with the purpose of prophetic education and the opportunity for a deed that remains.
shortened: All the Prophets and Messengers were sent by the Lord of the worlds so that, through the endeavors of those holy souls, the suns of spiritual virtues might shine forth from the horizons of human temples. Strive thou to attain to such a station that mention of it shall endure as long as God's most beautiful names endure.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Say: O servant, hear My words! By God the Truth, thou shalt not find for thyself a counselor more faithful than I. Tarry not upon the Path, but pass along it as a cloud passeth.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: While time remaineth and opportunity existeth, strive that perchance thou mayest attain to that which beseemeth the days of God. This is the counsel of the Wronged One unto the friends of God. Blessed is he who heareth and acteth, and woe unto the heedless.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: The Most Exalted Pen commands: O friends! Hold fast to that which is the cause of exaltation and elevation and the means of raising up the Cause among the servants of God - glorified be His majesty. Whatsoever He has commanded has been and continues to be for the good of His servants. Every person of insight bears witness to what has been mentioned, and every hearing ear is aware.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: O people of God! Today the Blessed Tree hath no need of aught else to establish His Cause, for it hath appeared with countless sweet fruits, manifest and evident. Blessed is the one whom the doubts of the world have not prevented from turning to God nor held back from drawing nigh unto Him.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: O Muhammad! Verily thy Lord hath been with His loved ones and heareth their call in His remembrance and praise - He heareth and seeth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. We counsel thee and those who have believed with that which will exalt this mighty, wondrous Cause. Say: O people of God! Adorn your heads with the crowns of detachment and your temples with the raiment of chastity, trustworthiness, truthfulness and purity.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Strive, O people, that your names may be mentioned before the Throne and there may appear from you that whereby your remembrance shall endure through the eternity of God, the Lord of existence.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: O handmaidens of God! Strive that ye may become the source of goodly deeds and that your mention may endure through the Most Great Remembrance.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: O handmaid of Glory! Hold fast to the hem of grandeur and cling to the sure handle and trust in God.

Therefore strive for that which brings elevation and ascension in the Most Glorious Kingdom, that you may become a blazing star and a brilliant planet, a manifest sign and an unfurled banner, a radiation of manifest light and a splendor of the highest heaven.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: In truth, the days have been fulfilled, the years have passed, the times are straitened, the cup of life has been muddied. Then, hasten ye in these days, and with great humility illumine the globe of fervent entreaty with the lights of His unfailing guidance that God shall make of thee a resplendent and radiant sign on the horizon of His oneness, and a conspicuous banner on the mount of His singleness.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Let thy food be the heavenly table and thy drink the sweet waters from the ocean of oneness. Let thy gift become the flowing treasure of God and thy bestowal the water of life from the garden of Paradise, so that thy name may be exalted in the divine world and thy designation honored in the heavenly Kingdom.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Now doth this servant submit: O brother, strive that in these divine days thou mayest acquire infinite bounties and be blessed with eternal favors. By the True One Himself, whatsoever is lost by any soul in this day shall be difficult to recover.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: We convey greetings to the women of that land and bid them to sanctification, detachment, supreme chastity and supreme purity.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: The first thing incumbent upon the friends of God is to purify their hearts from rancor and hatred, to sanctify and cleanse themselves from bestial qualities, and to act upon the divine ordinances with the utmost joy and fragrance.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Take ye the chalice of eternity from the fingers of holiness, then drink therefrom by the leave of your Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted, and tarry not even for a moment.
Cast away what ye possess and take what God hath graciously given you, then journey in the wilderness of His knowledge and tarry not even for a moment.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Know the value of this Day and occupy yourselves with service, that there might appear from you that which will endure through the eternity of My names and attributes.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: At all times be engaged in the remembrance of the All-Merciful and summon the people to the direction of the All-Glorious. This is the fruit of human existence in this time and all times.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Take the cup of utterance from the hand of the bounty of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, then drink therefrom by this Name whereby the pillars of all lands have trembled.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: These are not days of grief - be thou engaged in the remembrance of the All-Merciful with the utmost joy and fragrance. Forget not the divine counsels which thou didst hear face to face from the tongue of the Most Great Oneness, and speak not that which would cause the hearts of the servants to be consumed.

shortened: Know thou the worth of this most exalted station. We counsel thee with that which will cause the elevation of thy station. The world is transient - look not unto it, but rather unto Him Who created and manifested it. This Wronged One hath ever enjoined upon His servants that which is conducive to the appearance of divine bounty and blessing.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: O Ismi al-Asdaq! Render thanks for that We called thee to appear before the Divine Presence, caused thee to hear and to behold the effulgences of the countenance of thy Lord, the Most Exalted, the Incomparable, the One, the Great; and sent thee back that thou mightest remind the people of that which thou didst behold and know, and summon them unto the Most Great Steadfastness, lest their feet slip by reason of the clamour of every sinful pretender. O My namesake! Call thou to mind, each day, that whereunto We admonished thee in Our presence. Verily thy Lord, He, in truth, is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: This is a Day wherein the Remembrance calleth aloud with the most exalted call, summoning all unto the All-Knowing, the One. Grieve thou not over anything, but rejoice in the Book of thy Lord. Verily, He is with His accepted servants. We have aided thee and taught thee that which the learned and mystics of the earth know not, save whom God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, willeth. Be thou steadfast in the Cause and firm in the remembrance of thy Lord in such wise that the allusions of the wayward, who have cast the command of God behind their backs and followed every rebellious devil, shall not veil thee.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened:
These exalted words were revealed in one of the Tablets addressed to one of the friends: Say: O My loved ones in My lands! Hearken unto the counsel of Him Who counseleth you for the sake of God. He verily created you and manifested for you that which exalteth you and profiteth you, and taught you His Straight Path and His Mighty Announcement. 
O Jalil! Counsel the servants to fear God.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Let not this perishable wealth bar you from attaining the presence of the sanctified Court of the Beloved, nor let this outward glory become a veil in the path of Truth. Unclose the eye of rectitude, open the vision of integrity, and bring the hearing of uprightness into the presence of God. Suffer not for a moment yourselves to be heedless, nor squander vainly this brief span of life in aught save the good-pleasure of God.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: We counsel thee to remember God and praise Him in thy days. The world and all that thou beholdest today shall pass away, but there shall endure for thee what hath flowed from My Most Exalted Pen in thy name in this forbidden station.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Say: O servants! Let not your station slip from your grasp. Know your worth and the worth of these days, and drink of the choice-sealed wine in the name of the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: I swear by the Light of the world that any deed performed in these days for the sake of God shall be reckoned among the most excellent of deeds. Strive that ye may attain unto that which befitteth and beseemeth the Days of God.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Under all conditions be engaged in offering praise and thanksgiving to God, exalted be His glory, and be humble and lowly before His loved ones. This Wronged One conveyeth His greetings and salutations to all the friends and counseleth them to that which is seemly. All must adorn themselves with divine attributes and spiritual qualities, for the world and all that is therein are not worthy of attachment, as that which perisheth deserveth not to be loved.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath attained unto His mention, though it be through a single word, and joy be unto him who hath heard His most sweet call on this wondrous Day. O loved ones of the All-Merciful in all lands! Remember your Lord with spirit and fragrance, and hold fast unto that which ye have been commanded in His perspicuous Book. He hath commanded you that which profiteth you - to this testifieth every discerning knower.

order.why: Return to the personal address of these texts and their call to preserve an opportunity through lasting deeds.
shortened: Act ye in such wise as will cause your mention to endure in the Book which none toucheth save such as are steadfast and firm. Let not the affairs of the world sadden thee. Rejoice thou in this remembrance than which nothing that hath been created in the heavens or on earth can equal.

order.why: Close by returning from the many particular counsels to their purpose in human life and shared peace.
shortened: O friends! A time will come when I shall depart from among you. I have done what needed to be done. To the extent of my strength, I have served the Cause of Baha'u'llah. Day and night throughout my life I have not rested.

order.why: Let the image of what benefits humanity remaining after the foam has passed draw together the guide’s concern with lasting usefulness.
shortened: Therefore, O ye who are intoxicated with the wine of the divine covenant and O ye who are lovers of the countenance of Truth, strive to become the dawning-places of the signs of divine unity and the rising-points of the lights of the Glorious Lord.

order.why: Return to victory through good deeds and character, with unity and fellowship as the accepted purpose.
shortened: Today the hosts which bear the standards of triumph and the banners of victory have been and continue to be goodly deeds and pleasing character.

order.why: Close with the explicit purpose of divine counsels: extinguishing hatred, elevating human life and uniting hearts.
shortened: O My Name! The divine counsels of the All-Merciful and the heavenly exhortations of the Lord are recorded and inscribed in every leaf, and the primary purpose hath been and is to extinguish the fire of hatred and animosity, and likewise to elevate and exalt their stations.

questions: What kind of person comes into view through the opening counsels on generosity, reciprocity, humility and practical care? Which of these qualities changes your understanding of what it means to offer someone advice?
How do these passages connect knowledge, words and deeds? What does it mean for conduct itself to teach, and what can the mirror in James or the builders in Matthew contribute to that inquiry?

How can a person help another grow while avoiding faultfinding, backbiting and harshness? What roles do self-examination, an awareness of hidden obstacles and respect for another person’s capacity play?
What distinguishes firm conviction from conduct that wounds or divides? How do the passages on nonviolence, trustworthiness, justice and reconciliation shape the meaning of strength and victory?

How might wisdom guide the timing and manner of action between slowness and haste? What changes when one considers the end of a matter, the readiness of those involved and the particular circumstances of a letter’s recipient?

What makes a deed endure beyond the moment in which it is performed? How might one counsel here become a practice of service, and where would the connected subjects on wisdom, honesty, goodly deeds or words and deeds take your exploration next?

references.label: 1 · James 1:19–27 · Hearing and doing
references.note: Read these verses in the King James Version, noticing the movement from receptive listening and restraint in speech to the practice of what has been heard. James’s image of a person who looks in a mirror and then forgets suggests a failure of sustained attention as well as action. Care for widows and orphans makes the discussion concrete. Compare this passage with the guide’s treatment of good deeds, a disciplined tongue and service to people in need. What helps an insight remain active after the moment of reading? How might listening change the way one offers counsel? Keep James’s Christian account of religious practice in its own setting alongside the Bahá’í texts.
references.verified: Read James 1:19–27 in full, King James Version, Bible Gateway, 2026-10-10. Verified listening, restrained speech and wrath, hearing and doing, mirror image, law of liberty, bridling the tongue, and care for widows and orphans.

references.label: 2 · Matthew 7:1–5, 12, 24–27 · Self-examination, reciprocity and practice
references.note: Read these passages within the final chapter of the Sermon on the Mount in the King James Version. Consider the relation between examining oneself before correcting another, treating others as one wishes to be treated, and building a life by practising what one hears. The houses exposed to the same storm provide an image of what supports a life over time. Set these teachings beside the counsel against faultfinding, the language of reciprocity, and the insistence on deeds in this collection. How might self-examination make correction more truthful and more compassionate? What would it mean for counsel to become a foundation? Attend to Matthew’s presentation of Jesus’ teaching without assuming that every theological claim in the two traditions is identical.
